name: Mega-NeRF Spatial Partitioning
definition: Decomposes a scene into spatial cells with centroids to train separate MLP submodules in parallel, reducing memory and training time for large-scale scenes.
summary: Mega-NeRF Spatial Partitioning decomposes scenes into spatial cells managed by separate neural submodules, enabling parallel training and memory reduction through distinct MLP weights and visibility-based data pruning.
